analysis.title: Orange Ritual Product Portrait
analysis.notes: A white cylindrical product floats over a saturated orange-to-red field, with an oversized dark human-like shadow creating depth and visual drama. Sparse white microcopy and edge navigation frame the hero while preserving a strong, immersive focal point.
analysis.heroPrompt: Create a full-bleed editorial wellness landing-page hero: a small matte white cylindrical bottle suspended vertically at center over a glowing orange and vermilion gradient background. Cast an oversized, soft-edged burgundy shadow behind and below it, suggesting a human silhouette without showing a face. Add sparse, tiny uppercase off-white monospace annotations placed asymmetrically around the object, thin decorative tick marks along the top edge, and a restrained white utility button in the upper corner. High contrast, tactile film grain, dramatic studio lighting, modern art direction, no logos or brand names.
